flavor.phonemic_palette: Mongol-Turkic backbone (vowel harmony; kh, gh, ch, sh, ng, q; -ai/-tai; agglutinative -chi/-khan) with a Slavic overlay (the sibilants, -ov/-ich patronymics, stanitsa/gorod settled register); theophoric on the Steppe morphs (Marakhai-, Tamendei-) with Slavic variants (Marakh-, Tulor-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Slavic + Steppe-Mongol per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Slavic + Steppe-Mongol register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'kypchan'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Kypchan — wary clan confederation of the grassland; freedom, strength.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Kypchan (Slavic + Steppe-Mongol) are a expansionist clan confederation people seeded in grassland, taiga. They prize freedom, strength, glory, lean toward the military sphere, and field horse_archers, light_cavalry, light_infantry. Outsiders are met as wary; their patrons touch war, storms, plunder.
